name: Veterans Day Open 2019

venue.name: Discovery Canyon Campus
venue.address: 1810 North Gate Blvd, Colorado Springs, CO 80921, USA
venue.details: PK-8 Cafeteria. Park near and enter through the PK-5 Entrance and follow signs. Same venue as Pikes Peak 2019.

information: We are happy to welcome everyone back to Colorado Springs for the third time this year, as we come together for a charitable cause! All are welcome to attend. Please note that this competition can only accomodate 85 competitors. We also ask that guests are kept to a minimum to ensure enough room for competitors. Be sure to register early to guarantee a spot in the competition! All proceeds will go to benefit the [Cincinnati Children’s Hospital Proton Therapy Center](https://www.cincinnatichildrens.org/service/p/proton-therapy) as well as the [Bold and Brave Kid's Foundation](http://boldandbravekids.org/). Extra donations will be accepted in the registration phase, and at the competition. No refunds of registration fees will be offered under any circumstance. *All registration fees will still go to benefit the Cincinnati Children’s Hospital Proton Therapy Center and the Bold and Brave Kids Foundation.*
